execution_note: Local frozen-model reproduction using all seven successful NASA IMERG yearly GitHub artifacts plus the existing full GloFAS and ERA5-Land artifacts. Hyperparameters, feature set, chronological cutoff, event windows, and threshold were not changed in response to test performance.
validation_type: historical independent-event hindcast; not a true issue-time 48/72-hour forecast benchmark
source_stack: NASA GPM IMERG Final V07 daily precipitation

protocol.threshold_origin: predeclared fixed threshold; not optimized on test
protocol.positive_window: event date minus 3 days through event date plus 1 day

event_level_note: At the fixed 0.50 threshold, only Makurdi 2022-09-26 had a threshold crossing before/on the documented event in the historical hindcast window (first crossing 2022-09-23, 72 hours). This is observational hindcast timing and must not be presented as a true operational 72-hour forecast claim.
audit_interpretation: The near-perfect training metrics versus much weaker chronological test metrics are strong evidence of overfitting / temporal generalization failure.
Calendar features (day_of_year and month) dominate gain importance, indicating substantial reliance on seasonal/event timing patterns in the small pre-2022 event set.
The test ROC-AUC shows some ranking signal, but PR-AUC and fixed-threshold event detection are too weak for production warning claims.

Do not tune the threshold, features, or hyperparameters using this 2022-2024 test set. Any improved model requires a new development/validation protocol with a separate untouched holdout or prospective NiHSA shadow pilot.
Do not restore the old 0.9928, 91% precision, 73% recall, 10 false alarms, or 48-hours-before-government claims.
